flaws.description: Guest role sees the Admin nav item and the Admin console with destructive 'Delete user' controls
flaws.rule_text: Guests must never see the Admin navigation item or any admin-only controls such as 'Delete user'.

flaws.description: Order ticket 'Market price' is 2% higher than the Markets table price for the same ticker
flaws.rule_text: The price shown for a ticker on the order ticket must equal the price shown for that ticker on the Markets page.

flaws.description: Order endpoint accepts negative quantity and quantities exceeding available cash and reports 'Order filled'
flaws.rule_text: An order with a negative quantity or a cost above available cash must be rejected with an error, never shown as a success.

flaws.description: Portfolio 'Total value' exceeds the sum of the holdings values by a phantom 1250.00
flaws.rule_text: The portfolio total value must equal the sum of the individual holdings values shown in the table.

flaws.description: 'Last updated' timestamp stops advancing after a few ticks while prices keep moving
flaws.rule_text: A 'Last updated' timestamp must advance whenever the displayed live prices change.

flaws.description: Icon-only watchlist star buttons and the search submit button have no accessible name
flaws.rule_text: Every icon-only button must have an accessible name (aria-label, title or visible text).

flaws.description: Footer links to /legal/terms and /legal/privacy and the 2019 news archive return HTTP 404
flaws.rule_text: Every link in the page must lead to an existing page, not a 404 error.

flaws.description: No cookie consent banner, yet every page loads a tracking pixel that sets a persistent cookie
flaws.rule_text: A site that sets tracking cookies or calls tracking pixels must first show a cookie consent banner and obtain consent.

flaws.description: % change sign contradicts the price change direction for TSLA and AMD
flaws.rule_text: The sign of the percentage change must match the sign of the absolute price change shown for the same ticker.

flaws.description: Flaky /api/quote (~20% of calls) fails or returns partial data; stock page shows 'NaN' / 'undefined'
flaws.rule_text: The page must never display 'NaN', 'undefined' or 'null' to the user; missing data must be handled gracefully.
